name: Millet Kheer
ingredients: ¼ cup little millet or foxtail millet, rinsed
steps: Simmer the millet in 1 cup water for 15 minutes until soft.
Add the soy milk and cook on low for 12 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
Stir in the mashed banana, cardamom and saffron and cook for 3 minutes.
Serve warm or chilled with coconut.
note: No sugar is added; the banana gives gentle sweetness. Chilled kheer thickens, so thin with soy milk.
